Test Description: Performs default value checks and masked write/read verification across PCIe0 SII RC registers using defined masks and expected defaults, then reports pass or fail based on mismatch counters.

2) For each writable register, iterate over predefined data patterns and write the pattern; skip entries marked to be skipped.
3) For each readable and writable register, read back the value and compare it to the expected value derived from masks and defaults; count mismatches.
4) After all patterns and registers are processed, if any default or write/read mismatches occurred, set failure; otherwise set pass.
5) Conclude the test by returning pass when no failures were observed, else return fail.
